study_identification_part.si_4_title: Characterizing the distinct imaging phenotypes, clinical behavior, and genetic vulnerability of brain maturational subtypes in mood disorders

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Patients and healthy controls were recruited from Shenyang Mental Health Center and the First Affiliated Hospital of China Medical University. Imaging was performed at a single site (First Affiliated Hospital, China Medical University).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We recruited 114 MDD patients, 60 BD patients and 404 healthy controls (HC). All the patients were recruited from the inpatient department of the Shenyang Mental Health Center and the outpatient clinic of the Department of Psychiatry of the First Affiliated Hospital of China Medical University, Shenyang, China."; "Structural MRI scanning was conducted on a Signa HDx 3.0 T superconductive MRI system (GE Healthcare, Little Chalfont, UK) at the First Affiliated Hospital, China Medical University."
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Zheng2024.pdf.md: Methods and materials / Participants, L69; Image acquisition and MRI processing, L71

answer.SINGLE-SITE: normative training (HC group) and subtyping analysis (Discovery and Replication patient cohorts)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The local HC dataset (N=404) was used to construct the GMV normative model. The Discovery cohort (N=174 drug-free patients) was used for subtype identification. The Replication cohort (N=268 medicated patients) was used to validate the stability and reproducibility of the subtypes. Allen Human Brain Atlas (AHBA) data was used for virtual histology and transcriptomic profiling of the subtypes.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "we used quantile regression model and created normative curves with age based on GMV in HC group and calculated individual deviations for each region; patients were clustered in two subtypes"; "In this study, the 174 drugfree patients constitute the discovery dataset (dataset 1), while the 268 medicated patients comprise the validated dataset (dataset 2)."; "Transcriptional data were acquired from the open access Allen Human Brain Atlas (AHBA) database"
